subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these 13 third-party action upgrades in secret-bound workflows after final-head supplier and runtime verification, or hold them until that verification exists?
rationale: The patch changes executable CI suppliers across workflows with credentials and publication access; repository policy requires direct dependency and Codex-runtime contract inspection before a confident approval, which is not established by the supplied Dependabot notes alone.

options.title: Verify privileged paths before merge
options.body: Review the upstream action releases and attach redacted final-head workflow evidence for the app-token, Docker, CodeQL, and Codex paths before merging.

options.title: Accept the supplier update
options.body: Merge after an owner explicitly accepts the release and secret-boundary risk despite the missing final-head runtime evidence.

recommendation.title: Verify privileged paths before merge
recommendation.body: Review the upstream action releases and attach redacted final-head workflow evidence for the app-token, Docker, CodeQL, and Codex paths before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The changed surface is entirely repository CI workflow ownership, and no individual current-main owner can be established from the available read-only evidence.
